name: Sime Darby Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sime Darby Berhad 对 UMW 板块旗下多家子公司进行清盘或解散，包括 UMW Innovation and R&D Centre、UMW Grantt International、UMW Lubricant International、PT UMW International 以及中国的 Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services。这些行动涉及润滑剂、研发及汽车销售服务等业务。工业与汽车板块在公告中未见新的扩张或合约动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Sime Darby Berhad carried out liquidations or dissolutions of several subsidiaries under the UMW segment, including UMW Innovation and R&D Centre, UMW Grantt International, UMW Lubricant International, PT UMW International and Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services in China. These actions involved lubricants, R&D and vehicle sales and services businesses. No new expansion or contract developments were announced for the Industrial and Motors segments.

segments.name: UMW
segments.note: 今年 UMW 板块对多家涉及润滑剂、研发及汽车销售服务的子公司进行清盘或解散。
segments.note_en: During the year, the UMW segment carried out liquidations or dissolutions of several subsidiaries involved in lubricants, R&D and vehicle sales and services.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: UMW Innovation and R&D Centre Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年9月12日解散，此前已于2025年6月10日进入成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: UMW Innovation and R&D Centre Sdn. Bhd. was dissolved on 12 September 2026, after having been placed under Members' Voluntary Winding-Up on 10 June 2025.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd 于2026年8月6日启动成员自愿清盘，该公司主要业务为制造、分销、销售及贸易润滑剂、润滑脂和特种产品。
actions.text_en: UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd commenced Members' Voluntary Winding-Up on 6 August 2026; its principal activities were manufacturing, distributing, selling and trading of lubricants, greases and speciality products.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: PT UMW International 根据印度尼西亚法律于2026年5月4日委任清盘人并启动清算。
actions.text_en: PT UMW International commenced liquidation pursuant to the laws of the Republic of Indonesia, with a liquidator appointed effective 4 May 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd 于2026年2月27日启动成员自愿清盘，该公司主要业务为制造及贸易润滑剂和特种产品。
actions.text_en: UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd commenced Members' Voluntary Winding-Up on 27 February 2026; its principal activities were manufacturing and trading of lubricants and specialty products.

segments.name: Motors
segments.note: 今年 Motors 板块涉及中国一家汽车销售服务子公司的解散。
segments.note_en: During the year, the Motors segment involved the dissolution of a vehicle sales and services subsidiary in China.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited 于2026年5月11日接获东莞市市场监督管理局注销通知并正式解散。
actions.text_en: Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited was dissolved with effect from 11 May 2026 following receipt of the deregistration notice dated 11 May 2026 issued by the Dongguan Municipal Administration for Market Regulation.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited 于2026年2月5日经股东决议进入清算。
actions.text_en: Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited was placed under liquidation following a shareholders' resolution passed on 5 February 2026.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: UMW 板块旗下 UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd 启动清盘，该公司从事润滑剂、润滑脂及特种产品的制造、分销、销售和贸易。
model_changes.text_en: UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd under the UMW segment commenced winding-up; the company was involved in manufacturing, distributing, selling and trading of lubricants, greases and speciality products.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: UMW 板块旗下 UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd 启动清盘，该公司从事润滑剂及特种产品的制造和贸易。
model_changes.text_en: UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd under the UMW segment commenced winding-up; the company was involved in manufacturing and trading of lubricants and specialty products.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: Motors 板块旗下中国 Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited 进入清算，随后于2026年5月11日解散。
model_changes.text_en: Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited under the Motors segment entered liquidation and was subsequently dissolved on 11 May 2026.
